fonts.label: Serif
fonts.description: Classic book serif for titles and literary cards.

fonts.label: Impact
fonts.description: Heavy condensed display face for punchy titles.

fonts.label: Rounded
fonts.description: Soft rounded sans, friendly and playful.

fonts.label: Script
fonts.description: Flowing brush script for elegant accents.

fonts.label: Condensed
fonts.description: Narrow sans that fits long lines.

fonts.label: Orbitron
fonts.description: Bundled sci-fi display caps, wide and geometric: titles, HUD labels, future dates.

fonts.label: Share Tech Mono
fonts.description: Bundled sci-fi monospace: terminals, typewriter captions, location/date stamps.

fonts.label: Audiowide
fonts.description: Bundled rounded retro-futuristic display face: logos, racing or arcade titles.

fonts.label: Rajdhani
fonts.description: Bundled squared, condensed tech sans: UI overlays, subtitles with a sci-fi feel.

fonts.label: Exo 2
fonts.description: Bundled modern techno sans, readable at small sizes: body text, lower thirds.

fonts.label: Chakra Petch
fonts.description: Bundled angular sans with 45° cut corners: military / game HUD titles, captions.

fonts.label: Oxanium
fonts.description: Bundled squared sci-fi display face with clipped corners: HUD readouts, titles.

fonts.label: Saira
fonts.description: Bundled wide squarish tech sans: bold titles, numbers, sports / military look.

textAnimIn.name: Fade
textAnimIn.description: Fades the text in from transparent.

textAnimIn.name: Slide up
textAnimIn.description: Fades in while sliding up into place from slightly below.

textAnimIn.name: Slide left
textAnimIn.description: Fades in while sliding left into place from the right.

textAnimIn.name: Pop
textAnimIn.description: Scales up from small with a springy overshoot; lively titles and labels.

textAnimIn.name: Zoom
textAnimIn.description: Grows from nothing to full size.

textAnimIn.name: Typewriter
textAnimIn.description: Reveals the text one character at a time, with an optional cursor (one character = blinking cursor, several = scramble/decode).

textAnimIn.name: Wipe
textAnimIn.description: Reveals the text left to right behind a moving edge.

textAnimIn.name: Blur
textAnimIn.description: Fades in from a soft blur to sharp; gentle, cinematic.

textAnimOut.name: Fade
textAnimOut.description: Fades the text out to transparent.

textAnimOut.name: Wipe
textAnimOut.description: Hides the text right to left behind a moving edge.

textAnimLoop.name: Pulse
textAnimLoop.description: Gently grows and shrinks in a loop.

textAnimLoop.name: Wiggle
textAnimLoop.description: Rocks side to side in a loop; playful.

textAnimLoop.name: Float
textAnimLoop.description: Bobs softly up and down in a loop.

textAnimLoop.name: Blink
textAnimLoop.description: Blinks on and off in a loop.

effect.name: Glow
effect.description: Soft coloured glow around the letters.

effect.name: Neon
effect.description: Bright neon tube look with a strong coloured glow.

effect.name: Hollow
effect.description: Outline-only letters with a transparent fill.

effect.name: Echo
effect.description: Repeated offset copies behind the text.

videoEffect.name: Fade in
videoEffect.description: Fades the picture in from black at the start of the range.

videoEffect.name: Fade out
videoEffect.description: Fades the picture out to black at the end of the range.

videoEffect.name: Zoom
videoEffect.description: Slow zoom and pan across the picture (push-in); brings stills to life.

videoEffect.name: Vignette
videoEffect.description: Darkens the frame edges to focus the centre.

transition.name: Crossfade
transition.description: The outgoing clip dissolves into the incoming clip.

transition.name: Dip to black
transition.description: Fades the outgoing clip to black, then up into the incoming clip.

transition.name: Dip to white
transition.description: Fades the outgoing clip to white, then out of white into the incoming clip; dreamy or memory scenes.

transition.name: Flash
transition.description: A quick bright flash hides the cut; punchy, for beats and reveals.

transition.name: Push left
transition.description: The incoming clip pushes the outgoing clip out to the left.

transition.name: Push right
transition.description: The incoming clip pushes the outgoing clip out to the right.

transition.name: Push up
transition.description: The incoming clip pushes the outgoing clip up and out of frame.

transition.name: Push down
transition.description: The incoming clip pushes the outgoing clip down and out of frame.

transition.name: Whip pan
transition.description: A fast push to the left with motion blur, like a whip pan.

transition.name: Slide over
transition.description: The incoming clip slides in from the right over the outgoing clip, which darkens.

transition.name: Wipe right
transition.description: A hard edge sweeps left to right, revealing the incoming clip.

transition.name: Wipe left
transition.description: A hard edge sweeps right to left, revealing the incoming clip.

transition.name: Wipe down
transition.description: A hard edge sweeps top to bottom, revealing the incoming clip.

transition.name: Wipe up
transition.description: A hard edge sweeps bottom to top, revealing the incoming clip.

transition.name: Circle open
transition.description: The incoming clip opens from a growing circle in the centre.

transition.name: Zoom in
transition.description: Rushes forward: the outgoing clip zooms in and the incoming clip continues the push; energetic.

transition.name: Zoom out
transition.description: Pulls back: the outgoing clip shrinks away and the incoming clip settles in from larger.

transition.name: Spin
transition.description: The outgoing clip spins away and the incoming clip spins into place; playful.

transition.name: Blur dissolve
transition.description: Both clips soften into a blur while they cross-dissolve; smooth and gentle.

transition.name: Defocus
transition.description: The outgoing clip goes out of focus, then the incoming clip pulls into focus.

transition.name: Glitch
transition.description: Digital glitch: picture bands jump sideways around a hard cut; tech, horror, hype.

transition.name: Shake
transition.description: A camera jolt around a hard cut; impacts and beat drops.

textStyle.name: Plain
textStyle.description: Bold white sans-serif with no decoration; the default.

textStyle.name: Caption
textStyle.description: Smaller bold white text on a translucent black box; subtitles and lower thirds.

textStyle.name: Outline
textStyle.description: Yellow Impact letters with a thick black outline; meme or punchy look.

textStyle.name: Neon
textStyle.description: White rounded letters with a pink neon glow and a gentle pulse.

textStyle.name: Pop title
textStyle.description: Large white Impact title with a hard drop shadow that pops in and shrinks out.

textStyle.name: Typewriter
textStyle.description: Light grey monospace that types itself on.

textStyle.name: Glow
textStyle.description: Italic white serif with a cyan glow that floats softly.

textStyle.name: Echo
textStyle.description: White Impact letters with pink echo copies that slide up in.
